description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.021 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Monitor SEC EDGAR M&A filings for US public companies. Use ticker with mode=company for tender offers (SC TO-T), going-private filings (SC 13E-3), merger proxies (DEFM14A/PREM14A), and issuer self-tenders (SC TO-I); mode=recent gives a market-wide feed. Returns filing dates, forms, parties, SEC links, and a polling cursor. Reuse next_filed_after after next_poll_after_utc for incremental monitoring. Primary-source SEC data. $0.021/call.
